jobs.title: Data & AI Transformation Director
jobs.description:
At PwC, our people in integration and platform architecture focus on designing and implementing seamless integration solutions and robust platform architectures for clients. They enable efficient data flow and optimise technology infrastructure for enhanced business performance. Those in integration architecture at PwC will focus on designing and implementing seamless integration solutions to connect various organisational systems and applications. Your work will involve creating robust architectures that enable efficient data flow and enhance overall business processes.

The Opportunity

As a Data & AI Transformation Director, unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. We are seeking a Director, Data & AI Transformation - Microsoft Practice to lead and deliver large-scale Microsoft-based transformation programs across cloud, data, analytics, and artificial intelligence. This individual will be responsible for owning end-to-end program delivery, managing executive stakeholder relationships, building high-performing delivery teams, and helping grow PwC's Microsoft consulting practice.

The successful candidate will combine deep expertise in Microsoft technologies, particularly Microsoft Azure and Microsoft AI Foundry, with proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs and offshore delivery organizations. This is a delivery-first leadership role focused on execution, client outcomes, and scaling delivery capabilities rather than pure sales or advisory responsibilities. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:

Delivery Leadership & Program Ownership

Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale Microsoft Data, AI, and Cloud transformation programs.
Own program outcomes including scope, budget, governance, risk management, quality, and delivery success.
Lead multiple concurrent programs and workstreams across complex enterprise environments.
Establish effective delivery governance, escalation management, and executive reporting structures.
Drive successful outcomes across strategic transformation initiatives and managed delivery engagements.

Microsoft Data & AI Transformation

Lead delivery of solutions leveraging: Microsoft Azure; Microsoft AI Foundry; Azure AI Services; Microsoft Fabric; Enterprise Data Platforms; Modern Analytics Solutions.
Support clients in cloud modernization, data platform transformation, and enterprise AI adoption initiatives.
Develop delivery roadmaps that align technology investments with business objectives and measurable outcomes.
Provide practical guidance on enterprise Data & AI transformation approaches and operating models.

Executive Stakeholder Management

Build trusted advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, Chief Data Officers, technology leaders, and business executives.
Represent PwC during executive steering committees, governance reviews, and program leadership meetings.
Serve as the primary delivery lead for strategic client engagements.
Communicate delivery status, risks, dependencies, and business impacts to executive stakeholders.
Facilitate decision-making across client, partner, and delivery teams.

Global Delivery & Offshore Leadership

Lead geographically distributed teams across Canada, the United States, and offshore delivery centres.
Manage complex global delivery models utilizing onshore and offshore resources.
Coordinate activities across delivery teams, vendors, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders.
Establish delivery practices that support scalability, quality, accountability, and operational excellence.
Drive issue resolution, risk mitigation, and program recovery efforts where required.

Talent Development & Practice Growth

Build and scale high-performing delivery teams.
Leverage professional networks to identify, attract, and develop top Microsoft delivery talent.
Mentor Managers, Senior Managers, Architects, and Delivery Leaders.
Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.
Contribute to the ongoing growth of PwC's Microsoft Data & AI practice.

Business Development & Alliance Growth

Support pursuits, proposals, executive presentations, and solution development activities.
Build and strengthen relationships with Microsoft and key client stakeholders.
Contribute to thought leadership and market-facing initiatives related to Microsoft Data & AI solutions.
Help develop delivery offerings, accelerators, and go-to-market capabilities.
Support long-term practice growth and strategic expansion objectives.

What You'll Bring

Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:

12+ years of professional experience in technology consulting, enterprise transformation, cloud delivery, or technology leadership.
10+ years of experience leading large-scale enterprise technology programs and delivery organizations.
Proven experience delivering Microsoft-based transformation programs.
Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and modern Microsoft Data & AI technologies.
Extensive experience managing offshore and global delivery teams.
Demonstrated success managing executive-level stakeholder relationships and steering committees.
Experience leading large multidisciplinary teams across delivery, architecture, engineering, and business functions.
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and client relationship management capabilities.
Experience owning complex budgets, delivery risks, resource plans, and program governance.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead large-scale client engagements with limited oversight.

This position ensures continuity and upholds our standards of excellence following the departure of a valued team member.

The salary range for this position is $191,200 - $241,200. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centres. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhere to all relevant pay transparency legislation. During the hiring process, our Talent Acquisition team will provide details about our comprehensive total rewards package.

Why you’ll love PwC

We’re inspiring and empowering our people to change the world. Powered by the latest technology, you’ll be a part of diverse teams helping public and private clients build trust and deliver sustained outcomes. This meaningful work, and our continuous development environment, will take your career to the next level. We reward your impact, and support your wellbeing, through a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits and flexibility programs that will help you thrive in work and life. jobs.title: Director, Digital Safety
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a role where you can define the future of digital safety in a complex, mission-critical environment? Can you see yourself leading enterprise-wide cybersecurity programs while establishing the standards, controls, and governance frameworks that protect critical digital systems and information assets? If you answered yes, this may be the job for you. Apply today,
as our Chalk River location is looking for a Director, Digital Safety
to lead the development and implementation of CNL's Digital Safety Framework.

What you will be doing!

Digital Safety Framework & Standards Authority
Defining, maintaining, and evolving the enterprise Digital Safety Framework, incorporating nuclear safety principles such as defence-in-depth, graded approach, and continuous improvement.
Establishing and governing mandatory, non-negotiable digital safety control requirements applicable to:
Information systems
Operational technologies
Nuclear-related digital assets
Identity and access managemen
Data protection and asset lifecycle management

Translating external standards (CSA N290.7, ISO 27001, NIST, IAEA) into a cohesive, internally consistent Digital Safety Framework.
Defining the baseline conditions required for safe digital operations, ensuring clarity in expectations across all business and operational areas.

Program Implementation
Embedding Digital Safety requirements into all business processes, projects, and operational activities to obtain compliance with defined safety standards.
Developing and delivering enterprise-wide programs to build digital safety awareness, competency, and behavioural accountability.
Driving the integration of human factors and behavioural science into digital safety practices, reinforcing safe decision-making and risk-awareness across the workforce.
Promoting and enforcing understanding so that all employees and contractors understand their role in maintaining digital safety and operate within defined safety expectations.

Control Oversight and Operational Assurance
Exercising authority to mandate that all digital systems and activities comply with established Digital Safety requirements.
Conducting assessments, audits, and monitoring to validate adherence to safety standards and identifying gaps or vulnerabilities.
Leading incident response readiness and coordinating response activities, ensuring compliance with defined safety and regulatory requirements.
Maintaining enterprise visibility of digital assets and establish appropriate classification, protection, and lifecycle management.

Governance, Compliance, and External Alignment
Overseeing and confirming alignment with regulatory requirements and maintain readiness for audits and inspections.
Building and maintaining relationships with regulatory bodies, industry organizations, and external experts.
Monitoring emerging threats, technologies, and regulatory changes, incorporating them into the Digital Safety Framework as appropriate.

Leadership and Organizational Capability
Leading and developing a high-performing team of digital safety professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, excellence, and continuous improvement.
Developing workforce capability plans to build and sustain the skills required to execute Digital Safety objectives.
Managing budgets, resources, and priorities to deliver on strategic Digital Safety objectives.

Other duties as assigned by your manager.

What We Are Looking For

Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in cyber Security, Information Systems, Business Administration or related field, or equivalent work experience.
Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, ITIL) are highly desirable.

Experience
10+ years of experience in cyber security, with specific expertise in nuclear or critical infrastructure protection preferred.
10+ years in progressive leadership roles.
Demonstrated experience establishing and governing enterprise security or control frameworks.
Experience implementing and interpreting industry and regulatory standards (e.g., CSA N290.7, ISO 27001, NIST).
Proven ability to lead large-scale organizational transformation and embed control disciplines in complex environments.
Experience in operational technology (OT), industrial control systems (ICS), or SCADA environments strongly preferred.
Experience in managing budgets, strategic planning, and resource allocation.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
Ability to define and communicate a clear Digital Safety vision and framework aligned to nuclear safety principles.
Strong understanding of defence-in-depth, risk-based control models, and safety-critical system governance.
Exceptional decision-making and judgement in high-risk and complex environments.
Ability to establish authority and enforce standards in environments with competing priorities.
Strong influencing and negotiation skills, particularly in cross-functional and non-hierarchical contexts.
Deep understanding of current and emerging cyber threats and mitigation strategies.
Ability to translate technical controls into clear, actionable safety requirements.
Strong leadership and people development capabilities.
Ability to drive behavioural and cultural change across a diverse workforce.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage both technical and executive audiences.
Strong knowledge of:
CSA N290.7 (Nuclear Cyber Security)
ISO 27001
NIST Cybersecurity Framework
IAEA guidance and nuclear regulatory expectations
Familiarity with OT/ICS environments and digital instrumentation & control systems.
Understanding of how nuclear safety principles apply to digital systems.
Experience applying structured change management approaches (i.e., ADKAR).

Security Clearance Eligibility Required
Level 3 Secret requires a minimum of 10 years of verifiable history in Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the United States, and/or the United Kingdom. CNL implements security screening in accordance with the Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat's “Standard on Security Screening” and the “Policy on Government Security.”

Working Conditions

Working schedule: Five (5) days per week, seven and a half (7.5) hours per day for a thirty-seven and a half (37.5) hour work week.

Why CNL?

Does the idea of working with a dynamic team across Canada to advance nuclear science and technology for a clean and secure world
excite you? At CNL, we’re reinventing ourselves to be industry leaders— pioneering solutions to the problems that matter most
.

From building the next generation of clean nuclear and hydrogen energy technologies
, to developing targeted cancer treatments
, to continuing our global leadership in environmental remediation
—we are driven by impact, innovation, and purpose.

What We Offer: A Total Rewards Package

We believe in taking care of our people. Here’s what you can expect as part of our team:

Paid time off: vacation, sick, personal, and floater days
Benefits effective Day One – no waiting period
Tuition support to help you keep learning and growing
A defined-benefit pension plan or a defined-contribution pension plan, depending on your employee group, to support your long‑term financial security

Do Our Priorities Resonate with You?

Delivering clean energy for today and tomorrow
Restoring and protecting the environment
Contributing to the health of Canadians

If so, you’ll feel right at home at CNL!

Location: Fully Remote

This position is offered on a fully remote
basis, allowing you to work from home anywhere in Canada
. You’ll collaborate virtually with a dynamic team across CNL sites, helping to advance Canada’s clean energy and environmental goals from your home office.

Please note:
This is a remote position
supporting the Chalk River Laboratory, Ontario.

Our Commitment to Equity, Diversity & Inclusion

At CNL, we are committed to fostering an environment that promotes equity, diversity, and inclusion
. We celebrate and welcome employees, stakeholders, and partners of all backgrounds and identities. Click here to read all about it!

We are proud to uphold a workplace culture grounded in our Core Values
:

Teamwork
Accountability
Safety

These values drive our employment practices and ensure meaningful career development opportunities and accommodations
for all employees.

jobs.title: Director of GTM Data, Processes, and AI Enablement
jobs.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform
for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers
, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining
Autodesk Operations Solutions
, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations.
Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

The Role

MaintainX (part of Autodesk) is hiring a Director of GTM Data, Processes, and AI Enablement to own critical foundations of our GTM teams, including:

Customer and prospect data within our CRM;
Core CRM processes that enable selling across GTM teams (e.g., opportunity workflows, territory assignment processes); and
Our internal GenAI and automation efforts driving efficiency, effectiveness, and productivity of our GTM teams

This role also owns the integration of the MaintainX GTM teams into Autodesk GTM systems, processes, and GTM motions, for the core functional areas of the role – a key area of focus for the next 6 to 18 months.

The role sits in the broader MaintainX Revenue Strategy and Operations team and leads a small team of data quality analysts, but we expect this role to drive the majority of its impact through others outside of their direct team. Across all functional areas, this role will be working with, influencing, and directing the work of senior stakeholders, front-line managers, and ICs across Marketing, Rev Ops, Enablement, and GTM Engineering. We need someone with deep functional expertise that knows best practices and has rapid pattern recognition for solutions to GTM issues, who is technical enough to be credible with engineers, and is practical enough to be trusted by sellers to get work done.

What You'll Do

Own CRM data quality and governance

Set the strategy, standards, and governance for leads, contacts, accounts, and account hierarchies. That includes parent/child structures, holding companies, franchises, PE portfolios, and multi-site customers.
Move data quality from cleanup to prevention. Put in intake controls, matching and dedupe rules, and enrichment precedence, and track them on a data quality scorecard with targets.
Show leadership what data gaps cost in revenue, and make GTM data ready for AI use cases.
Lead the team doing this work, including writing requirements for GTM Systems to implement.
Develop deduplication strategies and processes to manage a dual CRM environment across MaintainX and Autodesk

Drive core CRM-based processes and workflows

Own CRM territory management developing the processes and systems requirements to implement the territory design and strategy defined by GTM leadership and Rev Ops teams.
Own our rules of engagement: account ownership, crediting, and conflict resolution across segments, regions, and teams – including both MaintainX selling in isolation and coordination between MaintainX and Autodesk sellers
Own optimization of CRM processes and workflows for end user teams, including building an understanding of current processes, identifying points of improvement, working with GTM systems and Rev Ops teams to define business requirements
Collaborate with Rev Ops, Enablement, and GTM systems teams to ensure field teams know how to use our systems and processes as they change, through release communications, training, and documentation.

Lead the GTM AI program for field teams

Run out GenAI and automation program for GTM field teams end to end: intake, prioritization and resource allocation across GTM and Engineering, operating cadences, solution evaluation, executive readouts, field enablement.
Lead discovery with Sales leaders to find the highest-value automation and agent opportunities. Align leadership and our GTM engineering team on one prioritized roadmap.
Own business requirements, build-vs-buy recommendations, and testing for centrally built solutions. Partner with Engineering to build and launch them.
Set the standards for how teams build their own solutions: knowledge base governance, a quality bar, and a path for scaling proven team-built tools across the org.
Own rollout with Enablement and measure adoption and ROI. The measure is workflows changed, not trainings delivered.

Lead integration efforts for MaintainX GTM into Autodesk

Own the GTM integration plan, governance and coordination across the workstreams, including: systems and data, account mapping and ownership, territories, sales process alignment, rules of engagement for joint selling, and enablement.
Coordinate stakeholders across both organizations. Run the cadence, track risks and dependencies, and escalate decisions.
Be accountable for integration outcomes, not just coordination.

About You

10+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM strategy at a B2B SaaS company, including 3+ years leading people.
Deep expertise in core sales processes, territory design, and rules of engagement.
Strong command of the CRM data model: Salesforce objects, account hierarchies, matching, and enrichment. You define and specify; you don't need to configure.
Hands-on experience bringing AI into GTM workflows (LLMs, agents, workflow automation), with results you can measure. Fluent enough to work credibly with engineers.
A track record of leading large cross-functional programs through influence, including with VP and C-level leaders.
M&A or GTM integration experience is strongly preferred.
Clear writing and speaking. You can make complex tradeoffs understandable to sellers, engineers, and executives.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running.
Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits.
Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging.
We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

The Director directly leads the Team Lead, Application Development; the Team Lead, Applications Support; and the Team Lead, Dynamics Centre of Excellence, and works with business leaders to translate organizational priorities into secure, integrated, scalable, and supportable solutions.

and Dynamics COE Leadership

Is accountable together with the Director, DS Operations for effective coordination among the Service Desk, internal application teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and managed service providers for Tier 2 and Tier 3 support, which the Team Lead, Applications Support carries out day to day

Partners with executive and functional leaders across Finance, Human Resources, Operations, Project Delivery, Marketing and Communications, Business Development, Health and Safety, and Corporate Services.

jobs.description:
Building the space between proven and possible, MDA Space (TSX:MDA) is a trusted mission partner to the global space industry. A robotics, satellite systems and geointelligence pioneer with a 55-year+ story of world firsts and more than 450 missions, MDA Space is a global leader in communications satellites, Earth and space observation, and space exploration and infrastructure. The MDA Space team of more than 3,400 space experts in Canada, the US and the UK has the knowledge and know-how to turn an audacious customer vision into an achievable mission – bringing to bear a one-of-a-kind mix of experience, engineering excellence and wide-eyed wonder that’s been in our DNA since day one. For those who dream big and push boundaries on the ground and in the stars to change the world for the better, we’ll take you there.

The Role

The PLM/MES Business Transformation Director
is accountable for leading complex, enterprise-wide PLM and MES transformation initiatives
across multiple business units. This role requires senior-level experience delivering large-scale implementations in highly complex environments, driving alignment across business, operations, engineering, quality, supply chain, and IT stakeholders. The role is responsible for translating strategic objectives into executable roadmaps, elevating processes and system capabilities to industry best practices
, and ensuring disciplined execution, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

Key Accountabilities

Lead enterprise-wide end-to-end PLM and MES implementation across functions, sites, and business units.
Align business strategy with operational priorities and program objectives for scalable enterprise processes.
Build and manage integrated roadmaps covering harmonization, solution design, deployment, change management, and capability enhancement.
Own program governance: scope, milestones, risks, issues, budget, benefits, and executive reporting.
Align complex, disparate requirements, decisions, and deployment priorities among business, manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, and IT stakeholders.
Guide cross-functional teams, vendors, and experts in a matrix environment.
Embed PLM and MES solutions into operations through adoption, governance, training, and continuous improvement.
Translate business and regulatory needs into actionable implementation plans.
Coordinate process design, configuration, data readiness, integration, testing, cutover, and stabilization.
Ensure PLM/MES capabilities align with enterprise platforms and digital transformation.
Drive standardization and best practices while balancing business realities.
Define success metrics, KPIs, and readiness measures for transformation programs.
Manage delivery risk, dependencies, escalation, and remediation.
Present concise updates to Steering Committees and senior leadership.
Focus on business outcomes, adoption, and sustained value post-deployment.

Stakeholder & Change Leadership

Serve as a trusted transformation partner to senior leaders across business, operations, manufacturing, engineering, and technology functions
Drive alignment across enterprise leaders with differing priorities, legacy processes, and business unit requirements to achieve common PLM and MES outcomes
Lead business change activities to ensure stakeholder readiness, process adoption, and sustainable capability uplift across impacted teams
Influence decision-making, resolve cross-functional conflicts, and drive timely executive escalation in a complex matrixed environment

Required Expereince

15+ years' experience leading large, complex enterprise transformation and system implementation programs
Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering PLM and MES implementations in highly complex, multi-business-unit enterprise environments
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field
Program or Project Management certification (PMP or equivalent)
Proven track record of managing multi-workstream programs with significant organizational change, cross-functional dependencies, and enterprise process alignment.
Experience working in matrixed or federated operating models across multiple business units, functions, and implementation partners.
Executive-level communication experience, including Steering Committee engagement, sponsor management, and senior stakeholder alignment.

Manage a project team of professionals of varying levels (including investments, legal, and other corporate partners as needed) to structure and complete complex reinsurance transactions throughout the global organization. Assist with coordinating the processes of analyzing transactions through interaction with the various technical experts in structured finance, accounting, legal, investments, tax, etc. Anticipate, identify, and resolve issues that arise during the RGA transaction analysis process to maximize the chance of a successful outcome. Lead negotiations with external parties ensuring that RGA’s financing needs are met efficiently and lead the implementation of legal entity optimization strategies, such as restacking efforts.
Establish processes that ensure financing transactions and support processes are implemented and administered properly.

Assists with oversight and management of other team members and manages direct reports (if applicable) through activities designed to improve processes and the ability to respond to external and internal customer needs.
Performs month-end/quarterly/annual financial reporting functions as assigned, primarily those associated with Structured Finance financing transactions, including recording financial activity, creating various financial reports, analyzing data, preparing general ledger uploads, and reconciling various general ledger accounts, administration of assigned internal retrocession agreements, balance sheets and income statement accounts. Maintain regular and predictable attendance.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Master’s degree in Arts/Sciences (MA/MS) preferred

Financial modeling experience related to structured finance preferred

3+ Years insurance/reinsurance accounting experience preferred

complexes à l’échelle de l’entreprise, couvrant plusieurs unités opérationnelles. Ce poste requiert une expérience de haut niveau dans la mise en œuvre de projets à grande échelle dans des environnements hautement complexes, ainsi que la capacité à assurer la coordination entre les intervenants des secteurs d’activité, des opérations, de l’ingénierie, de la qualité, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et des TI. Le titulaire du poste est chargé de traduire les objectifs stratégiques en feuilles de route réalisables, d’aligner les processus et les capacités des systèmes sur les meilleures pratiques du secteur
, et de garantir une exécution rigoureuse, une adoption efficace et des résultats commerciaux mesurables.

Principales Responsabilités

Diriger la mise en œuvre de bout en bout des systèmes PLM et MES à l’échelle de l’entreprise, en coordination avec l’ensemble des fonctions, des sites et des unités opérationnelles.
Aligner la stratégie commerciale sur les priorités opérationnelles et les objectifs du programme afin de mettre en place des processus d’entreprise évolutifs.
Élaborer et gérer des feuilles de route intégrées couvrant l’harmonisation, la conception de solutions, le déploiement, la gestion du changement et l’amélioration des capacités.
Assurer la gouvernance du programme : portée, jalons, risques, problèmes, budget, avantages et rapports à la direction.
Harmoniser les exigences, les décisions et les priorités de déploiement complexes et disparates entre les intervenants des secteurs commercial, de la fabrication, de l’ingénierie, de la qualité, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et des TI.
Diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles, des fournisseurs et des experts dans un environnement matriciel.
Intégrer les solutions PLM et MES dans les opérations au moyen de la mise en œuvre, de la gouvernance, de la formation et de l’amélioration continue.
Traduire les besoins opérationnels et réglementaires en plans de mise en œuvre concrets.
Coordonner la conception des processus, la configuration, la préparation des données, l’intégration, les essais, la mise en service et la stabilisation.
Veiller à ce que les capacités PLM/MES s’alignent sur les plateformes d’entreprise et la transformation numérique.
Promouvoir la normalisation et les meilleures pratiques tout en tenant compte des réalités opérationnelles.
Définir des indicateurs de réussite, des indicateurs de rendement clé (IRC) et des mesures de préparation pour les programmes de transformation.
Gérer les risques liés à la mise en œuvre, les dépendances, les recours hiérarchiques et les mesures correctives.
Présenter des rapports concis aux comités directeurs et à la direction.
Se concentrer sur les résultats opérationnels, l’adoption du projet et la création de valeur durable après le déploiement.

Leadership auprès des intervenants et gestion du changement

Agir à titre de partenaire de confiance en matière de transformation auprès des responsables des fonctions commerciales, opérationnelles, de fabrication, d’ingénierie et technologiques
Favoriser l’alignement entre les responsables de l’entreprise ayant des priorités, des processus hérités et des exigences opérationnelles divergentes afin d’atteindre des résultats communs en matière de PLM et de MES
Diriger les activités de changement organisationnel afin de garantir la préparation des intervenants, l’adoption des processus et l’amélioration durable des capacités au sein des équipes concernées par les répercussions
Influencer la prise de décision, résoudre les conflits interfonctionnels et assurer un recours hiérarchique rapide dans un environnement matriciel complexe

Expérience Requise

8 à 10 ans d’expérience dans la direction de programmes de transformation d’entreprise et de mise en œuvre de systèmes à grande échelle et complexes
Expérience avérée à un poste de cadre supérieur dans la mise en œuvre de systèmes PLM et MES au sein d’environnements d’entreprise hautement complexes regroupant plusieurs divisions
Baccalauréat en gestion, en génie, en systèmes d’information ou dans un domaine connexe
Certification en gestion de programmes ou de projets (PMP ou équivalent)
Expérience avérée dans la gestion de programmes comportant plusieurs axes de travail, impliquant des changements organisationnels importants, des interdépendances interfonctionnelles et l’alignement des processus d’entreprise.
Expérience de travail au sein de modèles opérationnels matriciels ou fédérés, couvrant plusieurs unités opérationnelles, fonctions et partenaires de mise en œuvre.
Expérience en communication au niveau de la direction, notamment en matière de collaboration avec les comités directeurs, de gestion des gestionnaires et de coordination avec les intervenants de haut niveau.
Une expérience en matière de standardisation des processus, d’approches de déploiement à l’échelle mondiale ou sur plusieurs sites, ainsi que l’adoption des meilleures pratiques du secteur constituent un atout

Compétences en matière de leadership

Forte orientation vers les résultats, avec un penchant pour l’action et la responsabilité
Capacité à exercer une influence auprès des hauts responsables sans exercer d’autorité directe
Grande tolérance à l’ambiguïté et capacité à structurer des problèmes complexes
Pragmatique, discipliné et calme face à la pression
Une attitude de conseiller de confiance, alliant un sens aigu du discernement et un grand professionnalisme

new_jobs.title: PLM/MES Business Transformation Director
new_jobs.description:
Building the space between proven and possible, MDA Space (TSX:MDA) is a trusted mission partner to the global space industry. A robotics, satellite systems and geointelligence pioneer with a 55-year+ story of world firsts and more than 450 missions, MDA Space is a global leader in communications satellites, Earth and space observation, and space exploration and infrastructure. The MDA Space team of more than 3,400 space experts in Canada, the US and the UK has the knowledge and know-how to turn an audacious customer vision into an achievable mission – bringing to bear a one-of-a-kind mix of experience, engineering excellence and wide-eyed wonder that’s been in our DNA since day one. For those who dream big and push boundaries on the ground and in the stars to change the world for the better, we’ll take you there.

The Role

The PLM/MES Business Transformation Director
is accountable for leading complex, enterprise-wide PLM and MES transformation initiatives
across multiple business units. This role requires senior-level experience delivering large-scale implementations in highly complex environments, driving alignment across business, operations, engineering, quality, supply chain, and IT stakeholders. The role is responsible for translating strategic objectives into executable roadmaps, elevating processes and system capabilities to industry best practices
, and ensuring disciplined execution, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

Key Accountabilities

Lead enterprise-wide end-to-end PLM and MES implementation across functions, sites, and business units.
Align business strategy with operational priorities and program objectives for scalable enterprise processes.
Build and manage integrated roadmaps covering harmonization, solution design, deployment, change management, and capability enhancement.
Own program governance: scope, milestones, risks, issues, budget, benefits, and executive reporting.
Align complex, disparate requirements, decisions, and deployment priorities among business, manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, and IT stakeholders.
Guide cross-functional teams, vendors, and experts in a matrix environment.
Embed PLM and MES solutions into operations through adoption, governance, training, and continuous improvement.
Translate business and regulatory needs into actionable implementation plans.
Coordinate process design, configuration, data readiness, integration, testing, cutover, and stabilization.
Ensure PLM/MES capabilities align with enterprise platforms and digital transformation.
Drive standardization and best practices while balancing business realities.
Define success metrics, KPIs, and readiness measures for transformation programs.
Manage delivery risk, dependencies, escalation, and remediation.
Present concise updates to Steering Committees and senior leadership.
Focus on business outcomes, adoption, and sustained value post-deployment.

Stakeholder & Change Leadership

Serve as a trusted transformation partner to senior leaders across business, operations, manufacturing, engineering, and technology functions
Drive alignment across enterprise leaders with differing priorities, legacy processes, and business unit requirements to achieve common PLM and MES outcomes
Lead business change activities to ensure stakeholder readiness, process adoption, and sustainable capability uplift across impacted teams
Influence decision-making, resolve cross-functional conflicts, and drive timely executive escalation in a complex matrixed environment

Required Expereince

15+ years' experience leading large, complex enterprise transformation and system implementation programs
Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering PLM and MES implementations in highly complex, multi-business-unit enterprise environments
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field
Program or Project Management certification (PMP or equivalent)
Proven track record of managing multi-workstream programs with significant organizational change, cross-functional dependencies, and enterprise process alignment.
Experience working in matrixed or federated operating models across multiple business units, functions, and implementation partners.
Executive-level communication experience, including Steering Committee engagement, sponsor management, and senior stakeholder alignment.
Experience with process standardization, global template or multi-site deployment approaches, and industry best practice adoption is an asset

Leadership Capabilities

Strong outcome‑orientation with a bias for action and accountability
Ability to influence at senior levels without direct authority
High tolerance for ambiguity and ability to structure complex problems
Pragmatic, disciplined, and calm under pressure
Trusted advisor mindset with strong judgment and professionalism

Special Considerations

Successful candidates must obtain and hold security clearance at the Reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Controlled Goods Program (CGP), and be able to obtain higher clearances.

Benefits Statement

MDA Space offers competitive compensation and benefits to its employees at all of its locations. As a member of the MDA Space team, you and your eligible dependents can enroll in a benefits plan that provides a comprehensive level of protection through competitive health care, including: health care plans supplemental and flexible drug plans, dental and vision benefits, disability income protection, life insurance, group retirement savings plans and an employee assistance program and to their family.

Equal Opportunity Statement

MDA Space is an equal opportunity employer with a strong focus on diversity and inclusion. We are committed to treating all employees and candidates with respect and dignity. If you require assistance or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please let us know.

The compensation range for this position is $180-000-200,000 annually. The specific compensation offered will be based on the qualifications and experience of the successful candidate.

new_jobs.description:
You desire impactful work.

You’re
RGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies , we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

Coordinates cross functional project teams to develop financing solutions for RGA's regulatory entities. Leads and manages accounting and reporting functions on assigned structured finance transactions. Reviews and analyzes structured finance transaction information ensuring accuracy of data and design. Evaluates and recommends improvements to improve efficiency for internal financing processes.

Principle Duties

Manage a project team of professionals of varying levels (including investments, legal, and other corporate partners as needed) to structure and complete complex reinsurance transactions throughout the global organization. Provide a point of leadership as well as coordinate a collaborative effort to develop optimal solutions to meet legal entity and consolidated objectives.
Assist with coordinating the processes of analyzing transactions through interaction with the various technical experts in structured finance, accounting, legal, investments, tax, etc. Anticipate, identify, and resolve issues that arise during the RGA transaction analysis process to maximize the chance of a successful outcome. Work with the transaction team to identify any issues related to the transaction and coordinate with the appropriate technical experts to make sure these issues get properly resolved in a timely manner to maximize the chance of success. Note that this position does not need to have all the technical expertise to analyze a transaction and resolve every issue but must have enough of an understanding of the transaction, the issue, and the organization to coordinate an appropriate response to resolve issues and successfully complete a transaction.
Lead negotiations with external parties ensuring that RGA’s financing needs are met efficiently and lead the implementation of legal entity optimization strategies, such as restacking efforts.
Establish processes that ensure financing transactions and support processes are implemented and administered properly.
Work with business units to identify potential financing needs, including cash, collateral, and regulatory requirements, by currency. Provide technical subject matter expertise to design and propose solutions, including reinsurance structures, securities lending, structured asset designs, and other capital market motivated strategies to allow RGA to efficiently finance its regulatory requirements.
Assists with oversight and management of other team members and manages direct reports (if applicable) through activities designed to improve processes and the ability to respond to external and internal customer needs.
Performs month-end/quarterly/annual financial reporting functions as assigned, primarily those associated with Structured Finance financing transactions, including recording financial activity, creating various financial reports, analyzing data, preparing general ledger uploads, and reconciling various general ledger accounts, administration of assigned internal retrocession agreements, balance sheets and income statement accounts. This includes coordination with other departments or subsidiary management personnel to obtain and compile required data, reconciling, and recording financial results to general ledger, and analysis and compiling data based on a US GAAP and Statutory basis. May include preparation of quarterly and annual financial statements. Leads quarterly officer meetings for assigned subsidiaries
Supports the department’s internal control and audit compliance process. This includes, but is not limited to, maintaining the department’s internal control narratives and EUC and IPE/RR inventories, identifying and implementing improvements in processes and maintaining applicable sections of department procedure documentation, and leading the coordination of both internal and external audit requests.
Maintain regular and predictable attendance.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) in business, with emphasis in accounting, finance or actuarial science or equivalent related work experience required
Master’s degree in Arts/Sciences (MA/MS) preferred

Work Experience

8+ Years of experience in accounting, auditing, or structured finance required
Financial modeling experience related to structured finance preferred
Actuarial experience preferred
3+ Years insurance/reinsurance accounting experience preferred

Skills & Abilities

Intermediate understanding of the US Life insurance and reinsurance markets required
Ability to quickly adapt to new methods, work under tight deadlines and stressful conditions required
Advanced level of listening, investigative, analytical, innovation and critical thinking skills; Advanced ability to translate business needs and problems into viable/accepted solutions required
Advanced ability to design and structure financing solutions, including reinsurance provisions, which meet RGA’s risk/return requirements as well as financing partner’s needs and regulatory requirements. This requires actuarial and accounting skills to address risk issues associated with proposed financing transactions. required
Highly advanced oral and written communication skills, demonstrating the ability to convey business terminology that is meaningful and well received required
Expert ability to balance detail with departmental goals/objectives required
Highly advanced skills in customer relationship management and change management required
Expert ability to manage multiple projects and/or teams simultaneously required
Expert ability to consult with individuals across a wide variety of operational, functional, and technical disciplines required
Highly advanced persuasion and negotiation skills when working with internal/external customers required
Highly advanced ability to make timely and effective decisions and produce results required
Ability to work flexible hours to accommodate international projects across multiple time-zones required

Gain valuable knowledge from and experience with diverse, caring colleagues around the world.
Enjoy a respectful, welcoming environment that fosters individuality and encourages pioneering thought.
Join the bright and creative minds of RGA, and experience vast, endless career potential.

We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible
